prompt:
Small, fully-specified fix. Do it, verify quickly, commit, open the PR. Normal cosmo PR flow.

*** EXECUTION RULE — READ FIRST. A previous attempt at this exact task DIED by starting nix evaluations as background jobs and then exiting to 'wait' for them, losing all its work. DO NOT run anything in the background. DO NOT use Monitor or background tasks. Run each verification command in the FOREGROUND and wait for it to return. If a command is slow, wait for it — do not park, do not schedule a wakeup, do not exit before committing. COMMIT AND OPEN THE PR BEFORE YOU FINISH. ***

THE CHANGE — hosts/classic-laddie/default.nix. Delete these two lines (around 491-492):
    systemd.services.llama-swap.serviceConfig.CacheDirectory = "llama-swap";
    systemd.services.llama-swap.environment.LLAMA_CACHE = "/var/cache/llama-swap";
and delete the obsolete comment block immediately above them (around 487-490) that explains why cosmo set them. Do NOT add mkForce or mkDefault. Do NOT touch anything else — not llama-swap's settings block, not llama-cpp, not open-webui, not the models. Leave the main llama-swap comment block (~line 458) alone unless it specifically claims cosmo sets the cache; a mention that GGUFs are pulled via -hf into LLAMA_CACHE is still true.

WHY (already diagnosed AND already verified — do not re-investigate or re-prove): cosmo hand-patched these on 2026-07-25 because the nixpkgs llama-swap module then set neither a CacheDirectory nor LLAMA_CACHE. Upstream has since implemented both, with a better path:
    environment = rec { XDG_CACHE_HOME = "/var/cache/${...CacheDirectory}"; LLAMA_CACHE = "${XDG_CACHE_HOME}/huggingface/hub"; };
    serviceConfig = { CacheDirectory = "llama-swap"; DynamicUser = true; };
Cosmo's CacheDirectory line is now redundant (same value); cosmo's LLAMA_CACHE conflicts with upstream's, which is what breaks evaluation under the bumped lock:
    error: The option `systemd.services.llama-swap.environment.LLAMA_CACHE' has conflicting definition values:
    - nixpkgs .../llama-swap.nix: "/var/cache/llama-swap/huggingface/hub"
    - cosmo hosts/classic-laddie/default.nix: "/var/cache/llama-swap"
A prior run already reproduced that error under the bumped lock with the unfixed file and confirmed the fixed file evaluates cleanly. You do NOT need to reproduce it again, and you do NOT need to fetch PR #678's lock.

VERIFY — only these two, foreground, then stop:
    nix build .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.system.build.toplevel --dry-run
    nix flake check
Both must pass. Note under the CURRENT lock nothing will set these values after your deletion — that is expected and correct; the gap closes when the lock lands. Do not re-add the lines.

THEN COMMIT AND OPEN THE PR. Title: 'fix(classic-laddie): drop llama-swap cache overrides now that nixpkgs sets them'. Body: quote the conflict error, explain upstream now implements what cosmo hand-patched on 2026-07-25 so this deletes a superseded workaround rather than losing a feature, note no cached model data exists (llama-swap has never served a request) so the path change is free, and note this unblocks PR #678, stuck since 2026-07-28.
